SECURITY & DATA PROTECTION

Security, built in from the start.

Commerce-channel, buyer and accounting data need careful handling. These are the controls Reconcile Ready plans to apply to every connected account.

UPDATED 18 NOVEMBER 2026

Encryption

  • All traffic is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. Unencrypted connections are refused.
  • Data at rest, including databases and backups, is encrypted with AES-256.
  • Amazon, eBay, Shopify and Xero access tokens are stored in a dedicated secrets store, separate from application data, and are never written to logs.

Access control

  • Access to production systems is limited to named staff who need it for their role, and reviewed every quarter.
  • Multi-factor authentication is required for all administrative access, including hosting, source code and email.
  • Production servers are reachable for administration only over a private, authenticated network. They are not exposed to the public internet.
  • Each customer’s data is logically separated, and every request is checked against the account that owns the data.

Passwords and credentials

  • We never ask for your Amazon, eBay, Shopify or Xero password. Connections use each platform’s authorisation flow, and you can revoke them at any time.
  • Staff passwords must be unique, at least 12 characters, and stored in a password manager.
  • Access is revoked within 24 hours when someone leaves or changes role.

Monitoring and logging

  • Access to systems and data is logged. Logs are kept for at least 90 days and reviewed for unusual activity.
  • Automated monitoring alerts us to outages and suspicious behaviour.
  • Logs never contain buyer personal information or access tokens.

Vulnerability management

  • Operating systems and dependencies are patched on a regular schedule, with critical security updates applied promptly.
  • Automated vulnerability scans run at least every 180 days and after major changes.
  • Firewalls allow only the network traffic the service needs.

Incident response

We maintain a written incident response plan. If we discover a security incident affecting Amazon data, we notify Amazon within 24 hours. For other connected platforms, we follow their applicable incident-notification requirements. We also notify affected customers and the ICO as the law requires. Each incident is investigated, contained and reviewed.

Development and testing

Real buyer personal information is never used in development or testing. Test environments use synthetic data and are separated from production.

Backups and continuity

Encrypted backups run daily, are stored separately from the primary servers, and are tested by restoring them regularly.

Our people

Everyone with access to customer data is bound by confidentiality obligations and completes data protection and security training before being given access.

Reporting a concern

To report a security vulnerability or concern, email hello@reconcileready.app with “Security” in the subject. We respond within two working days.
